title: 4 Secret ChatGPT Prompts That Feel Like a Resume Cheat Code #Resume #chatgpt #jobhunting #aitools
transcript: What happens when you ask ChatGPT to rewrite your resume so that it's basically unrejectable? Sabrina Romanov recently shared these four secret prompts, so I tested them and they feel like a literal cheat code. First, you want to paste your resume and job description and then say act as a senior recruiter, analyze my resume against this job description. Give me a match score out of 100 and list the top five missing keywords that I need. Once you get the keywords, you want to stay in the same chat and run the second prompt. Rewrite my experience section to naturally include those keywords. Use the Google XYZ formula, accomplish X as measured by Y by doing Z. This next one's probably the most important. Say act as an applicant tracking system filter. Scan my new resume, tell me which sections a bot would struggle to read. Here's the final prompt so that you can actually prepare for the interview. Act as the hiring manager for the specific role. Ask me the three hardest technical questions you would ask. Then give me the perfect response based off my background. If you want these prompts, make sure to follow me and drop resume in the comments and I'll shoot them over to you.
